The Product Design Program at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya (UPJ) equips students with the skills to design innovative, functional, and sustainable products. The curriculum is designed to integrate creativity, technology, and entrepreneurship, with a focus on areas such as consumer product design, furniture, transportation, and digital technology.
Over the course of eight semesters, students are guided by experienced faculty through the creative process from research to prototyping. Modern facilities and industry collaboration, including support from the Jaya Group, strengthen graduates' readiness to tackle the challenges of the dynamic and impactful world of design.
Uniqueness
We have a distinctive color that other Product Design Study Programs don't have
What sets UPJ Program apart? We offer a dynamic, innovative approach that you'd be hard-pressed to find elsewhere.
Urban Lifestyle
Designing everyday products such as jewelry, ceramics, and housewares that blend into modern lifestyles
Urban Mobility
Creating innovative transportation solutions for urban challenges
User Behavior & Experience
Designing product experiences that are meaningful and connected to user needs.
Living Laboratory
We combine cutting-edge theory with practical learning through a student-centered approach. With fully equipped design studio facilities and direct collaboration with industry through our Living Laboratory
Join us and be part of a unique and dynamic desain product program!
3.5 Years / 7 Semester
Bachelor of Product Design (S.Ds.)
13
Future Career
Career Prospects for Graduates of UPJ Product Design Study Program:
Product Designer - Commercial & industrial product innovator
Furniture Designer - Modern furniture design specialist
Transportation Designer - Designer of urban mobility solutions
Design Entrepreneur - Product-based creative entrepreneur
Design Consultant - Applied design solution expert
With well-rounded competencies, our graduates are ready to compete nationally and internationally, creating design solutions that improve people's quality of life.
UPJ - Creating Product Designers with Global Competitiveness
Alumni Stories
I gained a wealth of knowledge during my studies in Product Design at UPJ. The knowledge acquired not only encompasses soft skills but also hard skills. The well-equipped lab facilities in the Product Design program at UPJ have trained me to develop my ideas into design concepts and materialize these concepts into prototype products.
The lessons provided during lectures are highly applicable in the professional world, covering both theoretical understanding and practical application.
The Product Design program is highly suitable for those aspiring to become entrepreneurs. We are taught how to provide solutions in the form of products with commercial value for sale. All that's left is to complement this with marketing and branding skills to enhance entrepreneurial capabilities.
Muhammad Rizki, S.Ds.
Product Design, Class of 2016, Product Designer Dhaulagiri
Few people are aware of what "Product Design" is, although almost every day they use products created by product designers to support their daily activities, ranging from transportation, gadgets, fashion, to household and office equipment—all of which are inseparable from the role of a Product Designer.
The Product Design Program at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya is the right choice for me, as someone who is passionate about the automotive field, especially in transportation and specialized vehicles. I have gained many positive experiences and activities during my time as a student. Both academic and non-academic activities in the Product Design program at UPJ have provided me with valuable insights for my career journey up to this point.
Best of luck to all prospective students of the Product Design Program at UPJ!
Rizkal Maulana, S.Ds.
Product Designer at PT. Btwice Future Technologies
During my 4 years of studying Product Design at UPJ, there was a wealth of knowledge to acquire. It wasn't just about creating or designing a product, but also about developing the product in terms of branding and business strategy. Additionally, I had the opportunity to participate in several exhibitions, allowing me to learn about other products and expand my network.
Moreover, I established numerous connections by meeting professional product designers and fellow students from various universities, both locally and internationally.
These experiences have become valuable assets for me in my professional career. The knowledge I gained in the field of product design has been incredibly useful and has greatly assisted me in my work, particularly in handling the furniture brand.
Nabila Rhuvianti, S. Ds.

Donna Angelina Sugianto, S.Sn., M.A.
Secretary and Lecturer of Department of Product Design
Donna Angelina is not only recognized as an academician but also as a practitioner in the field of jewelry. Several of her works have received awards, including the Korean Fashion Jewelry Award in China in 2010, as well as domestic awards such as The Best Modern Jewelry Category presented by Mutumanikam Nusantara in 2012, and The Most Elegant Pearl Jewelry for her piece titled 'Secret Garden,' awarded by the Ministry of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries in 2016. A graduate of Pelita Harapan University and Kyungsung University in Korea, Donna serves as a lecturer in the Product Design Program at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya, Jakarta, Indonesia. She teaches courses related to lifestyle studies, art and craft, and entrepreneurship. Besides her role in education, Donna is actively engaged in organizational activities within the Indonesian Industrial Product Designers Alliance (ADPII) in the Professional field.

Hari Nugraha Ranudinata, S.Ds., M.Ds., Ph.D.
Head and Lecturer of Study Program of Product Design
Hari Nugraha is a lecturer in the Product Design program at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya, Jakarta, Indonesia. He holds a Bachelor's degree in Product Design from the National Institute of Technology, Bandung, and a Master's degree in Design from the Bandung Institute of Technology. Additionally, he pursued a Ph.D. at Chiba University, Japan.
His focus in product design and research revolves around the processing and utilization of materials sourced from nature, such as bamboo and wood, to be used as the primary materials for various product creations. Beyond his academic role, Hari Nugraha has professional experience in several national manufacturing industries specializing in craft products, interior home appliances, and furniture.

Ismail Alif Siregar, S.Sn., M.Î‘.
Lecturer of Department of Product Design
Alif is currently a designer, researcher, and educator with a background in product design, serving as a lecturer in the Product Design Program at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya, Jakarta, Indonesia. He graduated from Trisakti University in Indonesia and Universiti Teknologi MARA in Malaysia.
His main design and research interests revolve around ergonomics, toy design, transportation infrastructure design, rapid prototyping, and 3D printing.
Alif has experience working on various projects for multinational companies such as Suzuki, and has provided national-scale training for the National Museum of Indonesia. Additionally, he has been a speaker at several international seminars such as the Indonesia – Japan Joint Scientific Seminar (IJJS) and the Asia International Conference of Art & Design (AICAD).
Furthermore, Alif has been involved in developing the prototype for the Rinus C1 electric car design, which has become an icon of the Product Design Program at UPJ.

Toufiq Panji Wisesa, S.Ds., M.Sn.
Lecturer of Department of Product Design
Toufiq Panji Wisesa, born in Bandung in 1983, pursued his undergraduate and postgraduate education at the Faculty of Fine Arts and Design, ITB (Bandung Institute of Technology). Panji, affectionately known as a ceramic designer, is actively involved in creating and has participated in various national and international art and design exhibitions.
Panji's artistic achievements include being a finalist in the Indonesia Art Award in 2010. He is recognized as an expert by the Ministry of Industry in the field of ceramics due to his contributions to the development of ceramic products in various regions. He has received several awards in his field, including Gold and Silver Medals at the Asia International Conference of Art and Design 2017 for the best product innovation category.
His contribution to Indonesia is evident through his active involvement in the arts since 2002. In 2016, Panji participated in a program in New Zealand (Auckland University of Technology) under the Ministry of Education and Culture scholarship for the development of visual arts and culture. Subsequently, in 2018, he joined the Art for All program in Bangkok, Thailand, representing Indonesian ceramic artists to create and contribute to the Art for All Foundation in Bangkok.
On the academic front, Panji has successfully collaborated with the Faculty of Fine Arts and Design at Universiti Teknologi Mara, Malaysia. This is evident through his involvement in nine international cooperation programs, including invited lectures, seminars, journals, and art exhibitions.

Teddy Mohamad Darajat, S.Sn., M.Ds.
Lecturer of Department of Product Design
Teddy Mohamad Darajat is an instructor in the Product Design program at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya, Jakarta, Indonesia. He holds a Bachelor's degree in Product Design from Bandung Institute of Technology, Bandung, and a Master's degree in Design from Trisakti University in Jakarta.
Since 1993, he has been actively involved in various research projects, particularly in assisting bamboo product craftsmen in the Tasikmalaya and West Java regions. This initiative expanded to working with wood as the primary material for furniture production in collaboration with small industries in South Tangerang.
Beyond his academic role, Teddy Mohamad Darajat has professional experience in several manufacturing industries, specializing in automotive, signage systems, and craft.

Dr. Zaki Saptari Saldi, S.T., M.Eng.
Head of Center for Urban Studies and Lecturer of Department of Product Design
Dr. Zaki Saptari Saldi is a lecturer at Product Design program, Universitas Pembangunan Jaya. His area of expertise includes additive manufacturing, engineering design, and technological product development, with a specialization in computer simulation-based design and engineering. Before joining Universitas Pembangunan Jaya, he was the Head of Product Design Engineering program, Universitas Prasetiya Mulya from 2016 to 2023. From 2013 to 2016 he was a research fellow at the School of Engineering, University of Warwick, UK. In 2012, he received his doctoral degree from Delft University of Technology, Netherlands, after completing a collaborative research project with the Materials Innovation Institute (M2i) and Tata Steel in the field of laser welding modeling and simulation. He obtained his Master's degree from Toyohashi University of Technology, and his Bachelor's degree from the Bandung Institute of Technology.

Profile :: Universitas Pembangunan Jaya (UPJ)
Profile
Vision
Menjadi Program Studi Desain Produk yang unggul dalam memajukan ilmu pengetahuan dan teknologi di bidang urban development dan urban lifestyle, serta membentuk manusia Jaya sebagai lifelong learner yang bermartabat dan berintegritas, yang memberi manfaat bagi masyarakat dan lingkungan.
Mision
Menyelenggarakan pendidikan yang berkualitas di tingkat Sarjana dan Pasca Sarjana dalam lingkup Desain Produk di bidang kajian urban yang bersifat kolaboratif dan multidisiplin untuk menghasilkan lulusan yang unggul dan mampu memberikan solusi inovatif dan kreatif.
Menghasilkan penelitian yang unggul terutama dibidang kajian urban dan diakui di tingkat nasional maupun internasional di bidang Desain Produk.
Memberikan impak terhadap masyarakat umum dan DUDI (Dunia Usaha dan Dunia Industri) melalui karya dan praktik profesional di bidang Desain Produk.
Menjadi tempat untuk menumbuhkembangkan manusia Jaya yang berintegritas, profesional, dan mempunyai jiwa pembelajar sepanjang hayat (lifelong learner) yang memberi manfaat bagi masyarakat dan lingkungan.
Objective
Mewujudkan program studi yang unggul dalam tata kelola, program akademik dan kurikulum yang kompetitif
di bidang Desain Produk dan mampu bersaing dengan universitas lain di Asia Tenggara.
Menciptakan atmosfer akademik dan budaya akademik di bidang Desain Produk sebagai universitas riset.
Menghasilkan ilmu pengetahuan, teknologi dan seni yang unggul di bidang urban lifestyle and urban development di bidang Desain Produk.
Menghasilkan pembelajar seumur hidup (lifelong learner) yang memiliki rasa ingin tahu yang tinggi, berpikir logis dan kritis, giat menerapkan keilmuannya di bidang Desain Produk.
Menghasilkan lulusan bermartabat dan berwawasan luas, kreatif, inovatif, tanggap terhadap perubahan serta berkontribusi nyata mengatasi masalah lingkungan dan kesejahteraan di bidang Desain Produk.
Menghasilkan percepatan keunggulan komparatif UPJ melalui sinergi dan kolaborasi di bidang Desain Produk.
Strategy
Strategi pencapaian tujuan disusun berdasarkan analisis yang sistematis sebagaimana dituangkan dalam dokumen Rencana Strategi Program Studi Desain Produk
Targets
Meningkatnya kualitas dan kuantitas dosen dan mahasiswa di bidang Desain Produk.
Meningkatnya relevansi dan kualitas pembelajaran di bidang Desain Produk.
Meningkatnya kapasitas inovasi, kualitas dan produktivitas penelitian dan pengabdian kepada masyarakat serta pusat unggulan universitas di bidang Desain Produk.
Meningkatnya kuantitas dan kualitas partnership Lembaga di bidang Desain Produk.

Institutional Representation Award IIDSA 4

Keberhasilan ini memberikan pengakuan terhadap dedikasi dan kreativitas para mahasiswa Desain Produk UPJ dalam menciptakan solusi desain yang inovatif dan berpotensi untuk memberikan dampak positif dalam industri.
